patches.name: Auto-enter Picture-in-Picture (JWPlayer)
patches.description: Makes the JWPlayer enter Picture-in-Picture automatically when leaving the app while a video is playing (Android 12+ auto-enter), and keeps playback running while in Picture-in-Picture.

patches.name: Enable Picture-in-Picture
patches.description: Enables Picture-in-Picture support for the ViuTV player activity (adds supportsPictureInPicture and resizeableActivity, and adds screenLayout and smallestScreenSize to configChanges).
